Dana (Marketing Ops): Heads-up — next week’s ‘Inference at Scale’ webinar will use Zoom with concurrent breakout sessions. Need a quick ops plan for recording strategy + how clips get into HubSpot within 15m of session end. Who’s on this?
Kai (Events): I can own Zoom config and cloud recording export. Main things: enable cloud recording, set to record active speaker + gallery view separately, and enable separate audio files. Also enable ‘record breakout rooms’ (Zoom setting lives under Account Settings -> Recording).
Yoona (Growth): For handoff — we want: registrant -> live attendee flag -> clip(s) per breakout -> enriched lead in HubSpot with clip links and timestamp metadata. SLA: SDR queue get a task within 15m of session end. Can we automate? :eyes:
Mike (RevOps): Yes. Plan I tested: Zoom Cloud Recording webhook -> middle service (we use a small Lambda) that: 1) downloads recording from Zoom, 2) runs ffmpeg split based on breakout timestamps metadata, 3) uploads clips to S3, 4) calls HubSpot API to attach clip links and create task. I can drop the Lambda and Zap skeleton.
Kai (Events): Quick Zoom checklist I’ll run before the event:
```
- Account Settings > Recording: Cloud recording ON
- Checkboxes: Record active speaker, Record gallery view separately, Record the participants' audio files, Record breakout rooms = ON
- In Meeting > Advanced: Allow host to record breakout rooms
- Auto-delete local recordings = OFF
```
Dana (Marketing Ops): Yoona — can you confirm required HubSpot fields so Mike can map them? Also we need ownership for creative clip export (thumbnail + 30s socials).
Yoona (Growth): Required HS fields: source:webinar, webinar_name, breakout_room_label, clip_url, clip_length_seconds, attended:true/false, lead_score_delta. Create task: title = "Follow up: {webinar_name} - {breakout_room_label}", assign = SDR-rotating. Also tag campaign = inference-apr-2026.
Mike (RevOps): Zap/Lambda notes: payload from Zoom webhook includes `recording_files` with `recording_start`, `recording_end` and sometimes `breakout_room` labels (if host set). Split command we use: 
```bash
ffmpeg -i full_recording.mp4 -ss START -to END -c copy clip_{n}.mp4
```
Then upload to S3: `s3://redwood-event-assets/inference-apr-2026/{clip_n}.mp4` and POST to HubSpot /crm/v3/objects/contacts (or engagements) with custom properties.
Kai (Events): Small gotcha: Zoom sometimes batches breakout recordings in a single file with chapters — our Lambda needs to parse the `recording_start`/`recording_end` per file and rely on host to include explicit breakout labels in the meeting chat (we’ll ask hosts to paste `BREAKOUT: {label} START: {ts} END: {ts}`).
Dana (Marketing Ops): Good call. I’ll prep a short host script they paste into the chat at the start of each breakout. Also assigning creative: @Ava (Creative) — thumbnails + 30s cut for socials, deadline = +8 hours post-event.
Yoona (Growth): For the 15m SLA: SDR queue trigger = HubSpot workflow that fires when `clip_url` is attached + `attended=true`. We’ll create a high-priority task and send slack notification to #sales-live-handoffs via webhook. Mike can wire the webhook.
Mike (RevOps): I’ll add a step in the Lambda: after HubSpot POST, call Slack webhook with payload: {"text": "New webinar lead: {name} — task created — clip {clip_url}"}. Also implement retry/backoff and idempotency key = meeting_uuid + clip_idx.
deploy-bot: Zoom Cloud Recording uploaded: https://zoom.us/recording/abcd1234 (simulated) 
Dana (Marketing Ops): Action items: 
- Kai: validate Zoom account settings + run test recording today at 11am PT.
- Mike: share Lambda repo + HubSpot mapping by EOD.
- Yoona: HubSpot properties + workflow spec by EOD.
- Ava: confirm creative acceptance criteria (thumbnail size, 30s cutpoint rule).
- Dana: host chat snippet and runbook doc (link forthcoming).
Kai (Events): Will do test and post logs in thread. :white_check_mark:
Yoona (Growth): If test goes well, we’ll route first 50 attendees to SDR queue immediately, remainder through nurture with clips.
Dana (Marketing Ops): Perfect — I’ll post the runbook link & attach example host chat snippet once Mike drops the mapping. Thanks team! :tada:
